page.title: Rental requests
page.subtitle: Your shop's request inbox: see which vehicle a guest asked for, when they need it, then approve or decline right here.

customer.heading: Customer
customer.noProfile: Not in your customer book yet

schedule.heading: Rental request
schedule.pickupWishHint: The exact pickup time is finalized when you approve.
schedule.deliveryFeeHint: The delivery fee is set on the booking once you and the guest agree.

actions.messageUnavailable: This guest requested by phone and has no XePrime account — call them or reach out on Zalo instead.

approve.title: Approve and create the booking?
approve.effect: Approving creates a booking and RESERVES this vehicle's schedule for the period below. Pricing follows your active policy.
approve.deliveryNote: This request asks for delivery. The booking starts with a 0₫ delivery fee — update it on the booking once you agree with the guest.
approve.scheduleConflict: The vehicle is already booked for this period — pick another pickup time or reject the request.

longTerm.title: Approve long-term rental request
longTerm.legacyPackageHint: This request was submitted before packages existed, so it carries none. Pick the package you agreed with the guest — the system deliberately does not infer one from the old date range.
longTerm.pickupPlaceholder: Choose the pickup date and time
longTerm.pickupHint: You can only pick within what the guest asked for. For any other date, reject the request and agree on a new one with them.
longTerm.returnHint: The booking lasts exactly as long as the package the guest bought — it cannot be edited by hand.
longTerm.quoteUnavailable: Could not load the package price — check this vehicle's long-term pricing before approving.
longTerm.wishLegacy: Legacy request — the guest did not state a preference

reject.title: Reject rental request
reject.reasonLabel: Reason for rejection (sent to the guest)
reject.reasonPlaceholder: Briefly explain why you cannot take this request
reject.reasonRequired: Enter a reason so the guest knows why the request was rejected
reject.reasonHint: The guest reads this in their notification, so write enough for them to know what to do next.

presets.vehicleUnavailable: The vehicle is not available for this period.
presets.scheduleUnavailable: We cannot accommodate the requested schedule.
presets.requirementsUnsuitable: The rental requirements do not fit our shop's policy.

states.emptyPendingBody: New requests from the marketplace show up here right away.
states.emptyFilteredBody: Switch to another tab to see the remaining requests.
states.emptySearchBody: Try a shorter keyword, or drop a filter to see the whole inbox again.
states.errorTitle: Could not load the request list

time.label: Rental period
time.empty: Tap the field above to open the calendar and pick your dates.
time.unavailable: This car is already booked for that period. Please pick another time.

pickup.self: Pick up at the meeting point
pickup.selfHint: Collect the car yourself at the host's location
pickup.selfOnly: This car can only be collected at the host's meeting point.
pickup.deliveryHint: The host brings the car to your address
pickup.addressPlaceholder: 123 Nguyen Van Linh, Hai Chau, Da Nang
pickup.feeNote: If any extra cost applies, the host will discuss it with you before updating the booking.

driver.pickupAddressPlaceholder: 123 Nguyen Van Linh, Hai Chau, Da Nang
driver.note: Route: {route} — {description}. Any surcharge is agreed with the host before the booking is confirmed.

otp.title: Enter the verification code
otp.hint: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone}. XePrime uses this number so the host can reach you and you can track your request.
otp.devCode: Dev code: {code} — shown in development only.
otp.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please verify your phone number again.

price.packageTitle: Price details · {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} package
price.chooseTime: Pick a period to see the estimate
price.choosePackage: Pick a package to see the price
price.savings: You save {amount} with the {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} commitment discount.
price.finalNote: The final price is confirmed by the host when they approve your request.
price.loadError: We couldn't load the estimate. You can still continue; the host will confirm the price.

done.title: Request sent
done.body: The host will review your request and get back to you. You can follow its status under your trips.
done.notReserved: The car is not held yet. Your request needs the host's approval first.

duplicate.title: Duplicate request
duplicate.body: You already sent a request for this car with the same period. Please wait for the host to reply before sending another one.

description.in_city: Driving within the city or nearby, route up to you
description.inter_city: Travel to another province and return to the pick-up point (round trip)
description.inter_city_one_way: One way to another province — the host may add a surcharge

longTerm.noPrice: This car has no long-term price listed yet — the host will quote after receiving your request.
longTerm.wishTitle: When would you like to collect the car?

hint.within_7_days: The host will confirm the exact pick-up date and time within the next 7 days.
hint.specific_date: The host will confirm the pick-up time.

approved.title: Booking created
approved.lead: The request is approved and the booking is created. The vehicle schedule is now held for this period.
approved.leadLongTerm: The request is approved and the long-term booking is created on the schedule you just set.
approved.next: Next: contact the renter to agree on a pick-up time, collect the deposit if any, then confirm handover right on the booking.
